answer: Cross-Epoch Drift Quota. Each identity must keep its behaviour within a bounded distance of its own prior-epoch profile, measured over called actions, timing, and counterparties. An identity that would wander beyond the quota in any epoch must first post a delay deposit held for three epochs; drift resets only at dawn of a fresh epoch. Attackers spinning up many identities pay the deposit plus a forced idle period per sybil, since fresh identities cannot act at full rate until they accumulate consistent history across the trellis of epochs.
